topic: Grouped campaign demo feedback and timing
summary_markdown:
The team demonstrated the basic functionality of Grouped campaigns to a client. While the demonstration was successful, concerns were raised regarding the current state of the feature.

One participant noted that the combined/grouped campaign functionality is still under development and will only be stable in a future release. They advised waiting until after the next official release for clients to review the new grouped campaigns, as the live production environment currently lacks this capability.

Another point raised was the need to consider 'reach' metrics further.
decisions: The basic functionality of Grouped campaigns was demonstrated to the client.
